newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - May 12.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast Defence Minister Bandama N'Gatta says the military is undergoing reforms, on both an administrative and structural level, which will create a more efficient force.
- Secondary school teachers' union orders five-day strike starting on Monday to call for better balanced salary structures between different teachers.

- State-run construction company SICOGI is to be privatised soon as part of a general programme of selling off state enterprises, says director-general N'guessan Jules Mamert. He said the company would be a good investment.
- The state is in favour of decentralisation of powers, which will benefit the various regions and will open new opportunities for the private sector, interior minister says.
